thread.title: Apple and Amazon Stock Are Acting Terribly Right Now

author: Home
title: Apple and Amazon Stock Are Acting Terribly Right Now
text:
Be prepared for the storm.
Apple & Amazon Shares Act Terribly Six months into September and shares of Apple ( AAPL ) and Amazon ( AMZN ) appear to have run out of steam. Both are down slightly month to date. The bulls should view this action as mildly worrying.
Hurricane Florence Note Hurricane Florence is taking aim at the Carolinas. Storm stocks such as Home Depot ( HD ) and Lowe's ( LOW ) continue to notch good sessions on expectations for storm-related sales lifts.
Around TheStreet Apple will unveil its latest tech products at an event in Cupertino, CA. today. TheStreet's tech reporter @AnnieGaus will be on the scene serving up live analysis.
